sources.title: NousResearch/Arete-27B - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We post-trained over Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to reinforce western values on a Chinese-trained model. We call this new model Arete-27B. Open source models give labs the raw tools to mold intelligence to varied preferences. The values a model ships with should not be the only values its users get to ...

sources.title: Arete 27B - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Arete 27B is a 27-billion-parameter model derived from Qwen3.8-27B for general assistance, agentic work and research into model value alignment. Nous Research used supervised fine-tuning on about 52.8 million tokens over two epochs, without reinforcement learning, preference optimization or architectural changes.
